hr.approval_chain.v1.ApprovalChainLevelP.description: ApprovalChainLevelPayload is a single level within an approval chain pipeline.

approver_employee_id.description: Specific employee who approves; absent unless approver_type is specific_person.

approver_role_id.description: Role that can approve at this level; absent unless approver_type is role.

approver_type.description: Type of approver (direct_manager | dept_head | hr_admin | role | specific_person).

chain_id.description: Parent approval chain this level is part of.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

id.description: Unique identifier for this approval level.

level_order.description: Position in the approval sequence (1 = first approver).

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this level belongs to.

threshold_max_value.description: Maximum value that triggers this level; absent if no upper bound.

threshold_min_value.description: Minimum value that triggers this level; absent if no lower bound.

timeout_action.description: What happens on timeout (escalate | auto_approve | do_nothing).

timeout_days.description: Days before the level times out and the timeout_action fires.

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

hr.approval_chain.v1.ApprovalChainPayloa.description: ApprovalChainPayload is the ordered approval pipeline for a request type.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was created.

delegation_enabled.description: Whether approvers can delegate their approval authority.

id.description: Unique identifier for the approval chain.

levels.description: Ordered levels that make up the approval pipeline.

owner_id.description: Tenant owner this chain belongs to.

request_type.description: Type of request this chain governs (timesheet | leave | overtime | equipment | payroll).

updated_at.description: Unix timestamp when this record was last updated.

delegation_enabled.description: Whether approvers can delegate their approval authority.

id.description: Chain ID for update; absent (zero) to create a new chain.

levels.description: Ordered levels to set on the chain; replaces all existing levels.

request_type.description: Type of request this chain governs (timesheet | leave | overtime | equipment | payroll).

chain.description: The created or updated approval chain.

put.description: UpsertApprovalChain creates or replaces the approval chain configuration.
